description: Defines the FifoControllerBase class for managing read/write indices of a circular buffer in Android's audio system, including methods for accessing counters, indices, and buffer thresholds.

classes.name: FifoControllerBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for managing circular buffer indices and counters in Android's audio FIFO implementation.

methods.name: FifoControllerBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing buffer capacity and threshold.

methods.name: getReadCounter
methods.description: Returns the counter used by the FIFO reader.

methods.name: getWriteCounter
methods.description: Returns the counter used by the FIFO writer.

methods.name: getFullFramesAvailable
methods.description: Returns the number of valid frames available to read.

methods.name: getReadIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the next frame to read in the circular buffer.

methods.name: advanceReadIndex
methods.description: Advances the read index by a specified number of frames.

methods.name: getEmptyFramesAvailable
methods.description: Returns the number of frames available for writing.

methods.name: getWriteIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the next frame to write in the circular buffer.

methods.name: advanceWriteIndex
methods.description: Advances the write index by a specified number of frames.

methods.name: setThreshold
methods.description: Sets the maximum fill level of the buffer.

methods.name: getThreshold
methods.description: Returns the current threshold for buffer fill level.

methods.name: getCapacity
methods.description: Returns the total capacity of the buffer.
